parameters.jsCode:
const items = $input.all();
return items.map(item => ({ json: { ...item.json, _thread_meta: { sender_email: item.json.sender_email, sender_name: item.json.sender_name, subject: item.json.subject, date: item.json.date, thread_id: item.json.thread_id, message_id: item.json.message_id, labels: item.json.labels || [], _thread_label_ids: item.json._thread_label_ids || [] } } }));

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001', max_tokens: 50, system: 'You classify customer emails for a custom apparel printing company. Respond with ONLY one of these categories, nothing else: pricing_inquiry, order_status, quote_followup, capability_question, complaint, artwork_proof, general', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Subject: ' + $json.subject + '\nSnippet: ' + ($json.enriched && $json.enriched.thread && $json.enriched.thread.summary ? $json.enriched.thread.summary : '(no summary)') + '\nLatest: ' + ($json.snippet || '(no snippet)') }] }) }}
